name: Summit AZ - Supporting Blog Plan 2026-09-18
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-09-18

# Summary
Plan (no changes made) to push the blog posts that already perform onto page 1 using supporting posts plus internal links. Based on GSC for Jun 17 to Sep 16, 2026: the blog had 15 clicks, 4,050 impressions and an average position of 41.6 across 29 posts.

# Key findings
- Best performers: /blog/trenchless-pipe-lining/ (893 impressions, position 60.4), /blog/how-often-professional-drain-cleaning/ (509, 57.8), /blog/gurgling-slow-drains-when-it-rains/ (330, 9.1), /blog/signs-of-a-slab-leak/ (314, 57.4), /blog/are-water-softeners-worth-it/ (233, 13.7; closest to a breakthrough).
- A supporting post only helps when it covers a separate search need; otherwise it splits the same searches.

# Cluster verdicts
- Water softeners / hard water: write 3 supporting posts (B1 salt-free vs salt, B2 sizing, B3 maintenance).
- Slab leaks: write 1 (B4 "How plumbers find a slab leak") after a service check with Scott.
- Trenchless: no new post; differentiate the two overlapping posts instead (see [Summit AZ - F2 Trenchless Posts Changes 2026-09-18](lib:brain-summit-az-f2-trenchless-posts-changes-2026-09-18)).
- Drain cleaning frequency, monsoon drains, water pressure: no new post; improve the existing ones.

# Decisions and status
- B1 published Sep 18 and B3 published about Sep 25. B2 and B4 not started as of Oct 1.
- The plan includes an internal-link table with descriptive anchors for each new post.
- Facts to re-verify on writing day: Mesa hardness (the city now reports 12 to 22 gpg) and EPCOR San Tan figures.
